first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. Verify its segment targeting and downstream revenue quality, while checking onboarding evidence as the strongest alternative given concurrent completion and activation declines. Keep the test guarded because discounting may reduce margin or attract lower-value accounts despite near-term gains.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified evidence shows higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not pursue promotional pricing: its acquisition and qualified-revenue lift was offset by a 12% retention decline and failure through the first renewal cycle. Uncertainty remains about whether the earlier onboarding effect will replicate in the current cohort, so retain an experimental holdout and measure activation, retention, and qualified revenue.
